connector.name: Ermetic (Tenable Cloud Security)
connector.description: Pulls cloud security findings and IAM/identity findings from the Ermetic / Tenable Cloud Security GraphQL API

queries.name: get_findings
queries.description: Fetches all open security findings with full detail. Uses cursor-based pagination.

body.query: query GetFindings($first: Int!, $after: String) { Findings( first: $first, after: $after, filter: { Statuses: [Open] } ) { totalCount nodes { Id CreationTime Status Severity Policy { Name Description Category } Resources { ... on AwsResource { Name Arn Region AccountId __typename } ... on AzureResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } ... on GcpResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } } Remediation { Console { Steps } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

queries.name: get_findings_critical_high
queries.description: Fetches only Critical and High severity open findings.

body.query: query GetCriticalFindings($first: Int!, $after: String) { Findings( first: $first, after: $after, filter: { Statuses: [Open], Severities: [Critical, High] } ) { totalCount nodes { Id CreationTime Status Severity Policy { Name Description Category } Resources { ... on AwsResource { Name Arn Region AccountId __typename } ... on AzureResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } ... on GcpResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } } Remediation { Console { Steps } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

queries.name: get_iam_findings
queries.description: Fetches open IAM and identity-related findings (excessive permissions, unused roles, privilege escalation risks). Filters by the Identity category.

body.query: query GetIAMFindings($first: Int!, $after: String) { Findings( first: $first, after: $after, filter: { Statuses: [Open], Categories: [Identity] } ) { totalCount nodes { Id CreationTime Status Severity Policy { Name Description Category } Resources { ... on AwsResource { Name Arn Region AccountId __typename } ... on AzureResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } ... on GcpResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } } Remediation { Console { Steps } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

queries.notes: If 'Categories: [Identity]' returns no results, try Categories: [IAM] or Categories: [Entitlements]. The exact enum value depends on your Ermetic tenant version. Use the discover_schema query to inspect available Category values.

queries.name: get_iam_critical_high
queries.description: Fetches Critical and High severity IAM/identity findings only.

body.query: query GetIAMCritical($first: Int!, $after: String) { Findings( first: $first, after: $after, filter: { Statuses: [Open], Severities: [Critical, High], Categories: [Identity] } ) { totalCount nodes { Id CreationTime Status Severity Policy { Name Description Category } Resources { ... on AwsResource { Name Arn Region AccountId __typename } ... on AzureResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } ... on GcpResource { Name Id Region AccountId __typename } } Remediation { Console { Steps } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

queries.name: discover_schema
queries.description: Full GraphQL introspection — returns every query type and its fields. Run this once with your token to confirm IAM query names and Category enum values available in your tenant.

body.query: query { __schema { queryType { name } types { name kind fields { name type { name kind ofType { name kind } } } } } }

queries.name: get_finding_count
queries.description: Returns total count of findings. Useful for a health check or summary widget.

queries.name: test_connection
queries.description: Schema introspection query used to validate the connection and token.

ERMETIC_API_URL.description: Full URL of your Ermetic GraphQL endpoint, e.g. https://your-tenant.app.ermetic.com/api/graphql

ERMETIC_API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token generated from the Ermetic console under Settings > API Tokens
